security_spec.violation_condition: In QEMU TCG, when zama16b is enabled (ext_zama16b=true) but a compressed encoding (16-bit) of a base ISA load/store or F/D/Q load/store is translated without MO_ATOM_WITHIN16 set in the MemOp, violating the spec requirement that misaligned atomicity granule applies equally to compressed encodings. This occurs when a compressed load/store translator bypasses gen_load()/gen_store() and implements its own memory access path without independently checking ext_zama16b.
security_spec.vulnerability_pattern: trans_c_(lw|sw|ld|sd|lbu|lhu|lh|sb|sh|flw|fsw|fld|fsd).*\{[^}]*tcg_gen_qemu_(ld|st)[^}]*\} (without preceding ext_zama16b check) OR any compressed load/store translator that does not delegate to gen_load/gen_store nor check ext_zama16b independently
security_spec.summary: Compressed encodings of loads/stores must apply MO_ATOM_WITHIN16 identically to their 32-bit counterparts when zama16b is enabled; divergence silently strips guest atomicity guarantees

findings.finding: Zcmp pop (and cm.pop/cm.popret/cm.popretz) uses tcg_gen_qemu_ld_tl directly with memop derived from get_ol() and mo_endian(), but never checks ctx->cfg_ptr->ext_zama16b or sets MO_ATOM_WITHIN16. The memop is MO_UL or MO_UQ (4- or 8-byte loads >= MXLEN/2), so zama16b atomicity should apply. These are 16-bit compressed instructions performing multi-register stack loads, so they match the pattern 'compressed load translator not delegating to gen_load nor checking ext_zama16b independently'.

Zcmp cm.push uses tcg_gen_qemu_st_tl directly with memop derived from get_ol() and mo_endian(), but never checks ctx->cfg_ptr->ext_zama16b or sets MO_ATOM_WITHIN16. Symmetric to the gen_pop issue: 16-bit compressed instruction performing multi-register stack stores without the required atomicity granule annotation.

Zclsd compressed 64-bit load (trans_zclsd_ld/ldsp) calls gen_load_i64 which uses hardcoded MO_SQ | mo_endian(ctx) without ext_zama16b check. However, Zclsd is RV32-only where MXLEN=32, and zama16b per spec applies only to loads/stores of no more than MXLEN bits. A 64-bit load exceeds this bound, so MO_ATOM_WITHIN16 is correctly not required.
findings.snippet:
tcg_gen_qemu_ld_i64(tmp, addr, ctx->mem_idx, MO_SQ | mo_endian(ctx));
// No ext_zama16b check, but data size (64) > MXLEN (32) on RV32 -> zama16b N/A

findings.finding: Zclsd compressed 64-bit store (trans_zclsd_sd) calls gen_store_i64 which uses hardcoded MO_SQ | mo_endian(ctx) without ext_zama16b check. Same rationale as gen_load_i64: RV32-only, and 64-bit > MXLEN (32) places it outside zama16b scope per spec.
findings.snippet:
tcg_gen_qemu_st_i64(tmp, addr, ctx->mem_idx, MO_SQ | mo_endian(ctx));
// No ext_zama16b check, but data size (64) > MXLEN (32) on RV32 -> zama16b N/A

findings.finding: trans_c_lbu delegates to gen_load(ctx, a, MO_UB), which at trans_rvi.c.inc:413-414 checks ext_zama16b and sets MO_ATOM_WITHIN16. Correctly compliant.
trans_c_lhu delegates to gen_load(ctx, a, MO_UW), which checks ext_zama16b. Compliant.
trans_c_lh delegates to gen_load(ctx, a, MO_SW), which checks ext_zama16b. Compliant.
trans_c_sb delegates to gen_store(ctx, a, MO_UB), which checks ext_zama16b. Compliant.
trans_c_sh delegates to gen_store(ctx, a, MO_UW), which checks ext_zama16b. Compliant.
trans_c_flw delegates to trans_flw(ctx, a), which at line 52-53 checks ext_zama16b and sets MO_ATOM_WITHIN16. Compliant.
trans_c_fsw delegates to trans_fsw(ctx, a), which at line 75-76 checks ext_zama16b and sets MO_ATOM_WITHIN16. Compliant.
trans_c_fld delegates to trans_fld(ctx, a), which at line 58-59 checks ext_zama16b and sets MO_ATOM_WITHIN16 (for XLEN>=64). Compliant.
trans_c_fsd delegates to trans_fsd(ctx, a), which at line 83-84 checks ext_zama16b and sets MO_ATOM_WITHIN16 (for XLEN>=64). Compliant.

c.lw, c.sw, c.ld, c.sd reuse the same decodetree pattern names (lw, sw, ld, sd) as their 32-bit counterparts. This routes them through trans_lw/trans_sw/trans_ld/trans_sd in trans_rvi.c.inc, which call gen_load/gen_store. gen_load at line 413-414 and gen_store at line 524-525 check ext_zama16b and set MO_ATOM_WITHIN16. No separate trans_c_lw/sw/ld/sd functions exist to bypass this check.
